entries.headline: Shohei Ohtani connected at +179
entries.story: Shohei Ohtani cashed. Facing Tomoyuki Sugano, he went deep in the 5th in his 3rd at bat. The call: "Shohei Ohtani homers (28) on a fly ball to left center field." He added another later in the game. Final line: 4-for-5.

entries.headline: Freddie Freeman came close
entries.story: Freddie Freeman went 3-for-5 with 1 RBI against Tomoyuki Sugano and the Colorado Rockies. Closest call was a double in the 6th: "Freddie Freeman doubles (28) on a line drive to left fielder Jake McCarthy." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Janson Junk and the Miami Marlins. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
